Work from anywhere, anytime.</li> <li>Flexible vacation: take time off when you need it.</li> <li>Cultural diversity: be part of a diverse team</li> <li>Recharge days: balance between work and life.</li> <li>Diverse tech clients: work with various startups to stay creatively challenged.</li> </ul> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/uttr-project-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/uttr-project-manager</a></p> Wed, 09 Sep 2026 15:41:42 +0000 Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:41:42 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/uttr-project-manager https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/uttr-project-manager Toptal: Senior Security Compliance Consultant (SOC 2 & GRC Specialist) Anywhere in the World All Other Remote Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> </p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p><p>We are seeking an elite, hands-on Senior Security Compliance Consultant (SOC 2 &amp; GRC Specialist) to lead a critical, company-wide SOC 2 Type II audit readiness initiative. In this strategic engagement, you will perform comprehensive gap analyses, assess existing security controls, design robust compliance workflows, and drive cross-functional teams toward audit completion.</p><p>The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in GRC frameworks, control mapping, evidence automation, and policy development. Utilizing automated compliance platforms such as Sprinto, you will build repeatable compliance processes, validate technical controls, and ensure a seamless audit experience across the entire organization.</p><p><strong>General Information (About the Client)</strong></p><p>Our client is a fast-scaling, cloud-native technology platform committed to maintaining enterprise-grade trust, security, and data privacy. To support their rapid commercial growth and enterprise sales pipeline, they are establishing a formal, highly disciplined security governance model.</p><p>They operate a modern, cloud-first environment where compliance is treated not as a passive checklist, but as an active, automated operational advantage. By leveraging modern GRC platforms and fostering a security-conscious culture, they provide an empowering environment for compliance experts to drive real architectural and procedural improvements.</p><p><strong>Tasks and Deliverables</strong></p><p>SOC 2 Readiness &amp; Gap Analysis: Conduct a thorough assessment of existing technical and operational security controls, pinpointing compliance gaps and building an actionable remediation roadmap.</p><p>Control Design &amp; Implementation: Author, refine, and operationalize security controls, policies, and procedures aligned with SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (TSC) and PCI DSS standards.</p><p>Automated Evidence Collection: Lead evidence-gathering workflows using automated GRC tooling (Sprinto), ensuring all technical artifacts, access logs, and policy attestations are validated and audit-ready.</p><p>PCI DSS Guidance: Provide expert advisory on maintaining PCI DSS alignment alongside SOC 2, ensuring overlapping control requirements are mapped efficiently to reduce operational drag.</p><p>Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, HR, and IT teams to embed compliance workflows into daily operations without slowing down feature execution.</p><p>Auditor Interface &amp; Readiness: Serve as the primary liaison during the audit preparation phase, coordinating directly with external auditors to present evidence, resolve findings, and ensure a successful audit cycle.</p><p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p><p&g
